subtitle_id: Klasifikasi Diabetes dengan Jaringan Saraf Kuantum (QNN)
subtitle_en: Diabetes Classification using Quantum Neural Networks (QNN)
description_id: Proyek eksplorasi Quantum Computing yang menerapkan Quantum Neural Networks (QNN) untuk klasifikasi hasil diabetes menggunakan dataset klinis. Mendemonstrasikan penerapan teknik komputasi kuantum pada problem machine learning klasik.
description_en: Quantum Computing exploration project applying Quantum Neural Networks (QNN) for classifying diabetes outcomes using clinical dataset. Demonstrates the application of quantum computing techniques to classical machine learning classification problems.
architecture_id:
1. Quantum Circuit Design

  • Qubits: 8 qubit (satu per fitur klinis) untuk encoding data dan transformasi rotasi.
  • Framework: Qiskit 0.46.1 + qiskit_machine_learning 0.7.2.
  • Optimizer: COBYLA optimizer dengan callback tracking progress training.

2. Evaluasi dan Visualisasi

  • Metrik: Precision, Recall, Accuracy, F1-Score, dan Confusion Matrix.
  • Visualisasi: Decision boundaries menggunakan PCA (Principal Component Analysis) untuk representasi region klasifikasi.
  • Perbandingan: Performa QNN vs model ML klasik.
architecture_en:
1. Quantum Circuit Design

  • Qubits: 8 qubits (one per clinical feature) for data encoding and rotation transformations.
  • Framework: Qiskit 0.46.1 + qiskit_machine_learning 0.7.2.
  • Optimizer: COBYLA optimizer with callback tracking for training progress.

2. Evaluation and Visualization

  • Metrics: Precision, Recall, Accuracy, F1-Score, and Confusion Matrix.
  • Visualization: Decision boundaries using PCA (Principal Component Analysis) to represent classification regions.
  • Comparison: QNN performance vs classical ML models.
